item.title: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte posts bail after arrest
item.description: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte has posted bail after order issued for her arrest on charges she publicly threatened to arrange assassination of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and two others.
item.content:encoded:
Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte has posted bail after order issued for her arrest on charges she publicly threatened to arrange assassination of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and two others.

(Image credit: Aaron Favila)

item.title: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
